categories.name: Build Lab
categories.goal: Wins the arena against the other builds
categories.description: Found by the build lab: arena battles (game PvP rules) against the best build of every category and, round after round, against the builds the lab itself finds, searching substats, fairy, attack animation, skin stats and pets. The active skills barely matter there: the battles end before most of them come into play.

categories.name: Main Quest
categories.description: The builds that go furthest in the main quest: the furthest battle cleared (at least 50% wins in the battle simulator, every difficulty in order), searched from where the strongest builds already get.
